testcase.name: PERF-001 the load model and constants follow Model beban and Value sourcing
PERF-001 optionsFor(smoke) is exactly Rencana fase and Thresholds for the smoke profile
PERF-001 optionsFor of load, stress, spike, outage, and soak is exactly Rencana fase and Thresholds
PERF-001 the planned scenarios carry the rates, seconds, and planned iterations of plan.ts
PERF-001 VUs follow Alokasi VU and the actual load floor follows Thresholds
PERF-001 requestPhase takes the scenario suffix, and on outage the phase at the request start time
PERF-001 parseRunEnv accepts valid run variables and refuses empty, negative, fractional, or non numeric ones
PERF-001 classify follows every row of Klasifikasi respons
PERF-001 classify rejects extra keys, wrong migrations, bad checkedAt, missing no-store, 200 in outage, 503 outside outage, 500, and status 0
PERF-001 metricUpdates maps every outcome to the metric, value, and tags of the paragraph after Klasifikasi respons
PERF-001 recoveryValue records once per VU, only for a 200 received at or after T0 + 150000, and is never negative
PERF-001 k6ExitReason maps 0, 99, 107, other codes, and the timeout, with the real failed run as the 99 case
PERF-001 the real smoke summary holds every field result.json reads
PERF-001 k6 scripts import only k6 modules and relative .ts files inside tests/performance/
PERF-001 plan.ts and expectations.ts import nothing and never touch __ENV, process, or Bun; __ENV lives only in setupRun
PERF-001 every profile exports exactly options, setup, handleSummary, status, and readiness
PERF-001 durations normalize Go and short forms to whole milliseconds
PERF-001 the real k6 inspect output of smoke matches optionsFor(smoke)
PERF-001 the top level maxVUs of every real k6 inspect output is the peak VU of Alokasi VU
PERF-001 a copy of the real inspect output changed in one field fails the comparison
PERF-001 a copy of the real inspect output of a ramp profile changed in one ramp field fails the comparison
PERF-001 the image pins are valid, and wrong repositories, tags, or digests fail pin_invalid with the right detail
PERF-001 resource names, labels, and the network follow Topologi environment test
PERF-001 the PostgreSQL, backend, k6, and inspect arguments are exactly the topology table
PERF-001 the backend state inspect always uses --format with three fields only
PERF-001 the .env walk fails env_file_present on a .env.local and passes without it, without following symlinks
PERF-001 the container engine size check needs 4 CPU and exactly 4 GiB or more
PERF-001 the container guard accepts only this run names and labels, and recognizes a missing resource
PERF-001 the backend poll reads both endpoints and the expected migration count
PERF-001 the reason codes and setup steps are exactly the Kode alasan table, and details are cut to 200 characters
PERF-001 result.json holds the named fields in order, passes only without reasons, and records the load model
PERF-001 redacted() replaces every run credential, and the scan finds credentials in text and bytes
PERF-001 the worst case cleanup from the command limits stays 165 seconds
PERF-001 phaseWindows gives the smoke phases from the plan and the outage timeline with its targets
PERF-001 CPU and memory read as percent of one CPU and MiB from B, KiB, MiB, and GiB; control characters go; anything else is null
PERF-001 the docker stats splitter keeps partial lines, uses the time of the chunk a line ends in, and keeps at most 4 samples per container per second
PERF-001 the pg_stat_activity sample uses the fixed query of the spec, and its row must hold three counts
PERF-001 the summary reader takes actual load, latency, readiness, and thresholds from the real smoke summary
PERF-001 a missing submetric reads as count 0 with null statistics, a missing Counter as 0, and a missing summary as null
PERF-001 phase_start_late passes at 2000 ms and fails above it; iteration_request_mismatch compares http_reqs with iterations
PERF-001 every observation check of smoke passes on a complete observation, in table order
PERF-001 the backend checks pass and fail at their limits: state, output, 128 MiB peak, 50 percent CPU, and 16 MiB growth
PERF-001 the pool checks pass at 5 sessions and 1 active session and fail at 6 and 2; outage needs a reconnect in after
PERF-001 the generator checks pass at 240 percent and 1638 MiB and fail above, with the reason generator_saturated
PERF-001 observation_coverage judges sample counts, the 15 second gaps with edge gaps, and the 10 second pg_stat_activity gaps
PERF-001 clock_offset passes at 1000 ms on both measurements and fails above or without a measurement
PERF-001 outage_control fails a command sent early, sent more than 1000 ms late, or done too slowly, with outage_control_late per command
PERF-001 the outage control sends stop at T0 + 90 s and start at T0 + 150 s by the host clock, each after its guard and never early
PERF-001 a failure forced through a small limit records observation_failed or generator_saturated with the check name
PERF-001 the observation summary holds per container means and maxima, the backend state, the pool maxima, and the checks
PERF-001 the backend state, the other foundation.test containers, and the environment block read only what the spec names
PERF-001 Batas bukti is written as is with the migration count, and a full result.json holds every reading
PERF-001 observation.json holds the phase windows in host epoch ms and every kept sample
PERF-001 the real smoke summary holds one check and one metric sample per request, with the metric kinds of Metrik khusus
PERF-001 metrics.ts creates the custom metrics of Metrik khusus, and every trend holds time
PERF-001 the status journey sends one GET with the 10 second timeout and the endpoint and phase tags, and counts a transport failure as unexpected
PERF-001 the readiness journey judges each response in the phase its request started in, and records the recovery once per VU on outage only
PERF-001 setupRun reads the run variables only when called, waits until T0, and refuses an invalid value; writeSummary writes the summary and one fixed line
PERF-009 runProfile aborted while preparing cleans up through the guard in order, touches nothing it did not create, and records signal
PERF-009 runProfile aborted while running cleans up through the guard in order, touches nothing it did not create, and records signal
PERF-009 runProfile aborted while evaluating cleans up through the guard in order, touches nothing it did not create, and records signal
PERF-009 the outage run stops and starts only its own PostgreSQL through the guard, never before the schedule, then cleans up in order
PERF-009 a signal while PostgreSQL is stopped on outage sends no start, cleans up in order, and records signal
PERF-009 SIGTERM while main waits for SELECT 1 removes PostgreSQL, the inspect container, and the network through the guard and exits 143
PERF-009 SIGINT while main waits for SELECT 1 removes PostgreSQL, the inspect container, and the network through the guard and exits 130
PERF-009 SIGHUP while main waits for SELECT 1 removes PostgreSQL, the inspect container, and the network through the guard and exits 129
PERF-009 an unknown or path like profile exits 2 with the fixed message, without a docker call or a change under .local/feature-12
PERF-009 each pre-run check that fails stops before any network or container exists, records its reason, and exits 1
PERF-009 a PostgreSQL image without the pinned base is built through Compose with a temporary env file, and a failed build stops before any container
PERF-009 a run credential in a captured output fails secret_in_output, is never printed, and the run still cleans up through the guard
PERF-009 cleanup never removes what the guard refuses, records cleanup_failed with the name, and skips a resource that is already gone
PERF-009 a complete smoke run with a clean k6 summary passes, exits 0, and carries every measurement into result.json
PERF-009 each k6 exit gives exactly its own reason when the summary and the observation are clean
PERF-009 another foundation.test container after k6 fails environment_busy after:N, while the run own containers are ignored and nothing foreign is touched
PERF-009 every judged measurement reaches the reasons in order: summary timing and counts, backend state and output, samples, pool, generator, clock, and the stream stderr scan
PERF-009 a run credential in a stats stream line, in k6/summary.json, or in the structured result is found before redaction, fails secret_in_output, and is never written or printed
PERF-009 on host UID 0 the k6 output folder goes to 65534:65534 before any docker call, and the containers run as 65534:65534
PERF-009 every setup step after PostgreSQL that fails records its own setup_failed detail or backend_not_ready, never starts k6, and cleans up what it created
